note: Single-pass extraction by Claude reading the paper text; evidence references sections/figures/tables. No multi-run validation.

components.description: Uncertainty-triggered multi-trial decoding (CNTP) and its evidence

nodes.name: Standard decoding is suboptimal when uncertain
nodes.description: Standard decoding strategies (greedy, top-k, nucleus sampling) can produce dull or suboptimal completions in uncertain contexts, and temperature scaling with nucleus sampling gives inferior performance when the model is unsure about test questions.

nodes.name: Multi-sample methods are costly, single-sample risk hallucination
nodes.description: Extensive multi-sample strategies inflate computational cost, while purely single-sample methods risk hallucinations and local optimum traps.

nodes.name: Entropy as uncertainty signal
nodes.description: CNTP measures model uncertainty at each step by the entropy H(s) of the next-token distribution; high entropy means the model is more uncertain.

nodes.name: Adaptive trial count rule
nodes.description: CNTP sets the number of trials N = max(1, min(Nmax, (H(s)-Hmin)*Nmax/(Hmax-Hmin))), so N=1 when entropy is below Hmin and N=Nmax when it exceeds Hmax.

nodes.name: Select lowest-perplexity trial
nodes.description: At each step CNTP samples N independent candidate continuations until a punctuation token, computes each path's perplexity from its negative log-likelihood, and keeps the trial with lowest perplexity.

nodes.name: CNTP is training-free and self-contained
nodes.description: CNTP is a training-free inference-only decoding strategy needing no critic model, external feedback or domain-specific tuning.

nodes.name: Gains on Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct
nodes.description: With Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct, CNTP improves over stochastic decoding on GSM8K (81.6 vs 79.4), MATH (47.1 vs 41.5) and StrategyQA (73.2 vs 72.0), at 0.46k, 0.87k and 0.35k generated tokens.

nodes.name: Gains on DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-1.5B
nodes.description: With DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-1.5B, CNTP improves over stochastic decoding on GSM8K (65.7 vs 61.6), MATH (37.7 vs 27.9) and StrategyQA (53.0 vs 51.7).

nodes.name: CNTP combined with self-consistency
nodes.description: CNTP plus self-consistency (40 paths) improves over vanilla SC on Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct: GSM8K 85.2 vs 84.8, MATH 57.5 vs 56.0, StrategyQA 76.3 vs 76.2.

nodes.name: TruthfulQA improvement
nodes.description: On Truthful-QA with Llama-2-7B-Chat, CNTP reaches 74.0 truth-info accuracy versus 66.0 for stochastic decoding and 57.6 for greedy decoding.

nodes.name: Multimodal improvements
nodes.description: On Llama-3.2-11B-Vision-Instruct CNTP improves MMVet by 5.5 and MathVista by 5.0 over greedy decoding, and gives gains of 0.4 on both for LLaVA-CoT.

nodes.name: Positive entropy-trial correlation is best
nodes.description: Making trial count positively correlated with entropy (explore more when uncertain) performs best: GSM8K 81.6 vs 81.1 (fixed 6 trials) and 81.2 (negative correlation), and the alternatives yield repetitive text on TruthfulQA.

nodes.name: Moderate max trials best
nodes.description: Performance as Nmax grows first decreases then increases and saturates or slightly decreases, so a moderate Nmax roughly in [10, 30] works well unlike self-consistency, which keeps improving.

nodes.name: Higher cost than vanilla decoding
nodes.description: CNTP generates more tokens than greedy decoding (e.g., 0.46k vs 0.15k on GSM8K) but far fewer than self-consistency with 40 paths (6.03k).

isolated_nodes.name: Perplexity-range ablation
isolated_nodes.description: Selecting best-of-N by whole-answer perplexity on GSM8K (79.2 at N=2 falling to 76.1 at N=40) does not match sentence-level CNTP (81.6).

isolated_nodes.name: Robust to temperature and top-p
isolated_nodes.description: CNTP on MATH with Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct is robust to varying temperature and top-p values, while greedy and stochastic decoding stay around 41.5%.

structural_reasoning: CNTP design (entropy-triggered trials, lowest perplexity selection) leads to benchmark gains, combinations, and ablations.
